artwork.careInfoBody: Keep prints and originals out of direct sunlight to preserve color over time. Dust gently with a dry, soft cloth — avoid glass cleaners or solvents on the surface. Framed pieces should be hung away from heat sources and areas of high humidity.
artwork.returnsBody: We want you to love your piece. If something isn't right, contact us within 14 days of delivery and we'll arrange a return or exchange. Items must be returned in their original, unused condition. Custom framing and made-to-order prints are final sale unless damaged in transit.
artwork.shippingBody: Prints ship rolled or flat in protective packaging within 5–9 business days. Original paintings ship in a custom-built crate and may take 10–14 business days to prepare. Tracking details are emailed as soon as your order leaves the studio.
